title: Helion Energy
summary: US fusion company building a pulsed field-reversed-configuration reactor.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Helion Energy is developing a compact fusion reactor using field-reversed configuration and direct energy recovery, with a power-purchase agreement with Microsoft for a future plant. Its approach targets electricity directly rather than steam turbines. Technical milestones and funding determine credibility.

Technology Exposure

  • Fusion reactor development
  • Direct energy recovery
  • Power-purchase agreements

What To Watch

  • Net-electricity demonstration
  • Plant construction
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
